author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Gemini Spark transforms Gemini from a simple chatbot into an AI agent that can complete tasks, run in the background, and automate recurring work for you.

In this step-by-step Gemini Spark tutorial, you'll learn how to create tasks, build reusable skills, and set up schedules that allow Gemini to automatically complete work on your behalf. You'll see how to create kid-friendly content with skills, automate recurring jokes for your family, and build a personalized morning briefing that pulls together your important emails, meetings, and tasks into a single daily summary.
Whether you're new to Gemini Spark or looking for practical ways to automate your workflow, this tutorial will help you get started quickly.

In this tutorial:
- Create your first Gemini Spark task
- Build reusable skills
- Schedule recurring automations
- Generate personalized daily briefings
- Learn how Gemini Spark works as an AI agent
- Explore practical real-world use cases

Host: Kevin Stratvert
